title: Testing LCBs (Lithium Ceramic Batteries) || The Future of Battery Technology?
summary: GreatScott! tests ProLogium lithium ceramic batteries, a solid-state design. He measures their volumetric and gravimetric energy density, compares them to Li-ion and LiPo, and runs durability tests at the end.
why: HN commenters cite it as hands-on testing of a solid-state battery claim, though some remain skeptical until products ship.
